items.prompt: A framing-only FIX fixture passes checksum but omits required session fields. What follows?

options.text: It is automatically a valid authenticated order
options.why: Framing/checksum supplies neither complete schema nor identity authority.

options.text: Only the stated framing checks passed
Passing a checksum supplies every omitted mandatory session field
options.why: The checksum checks the supplied bytes only; absent required fields remain absent.

options.text: Every missing field should be invented as zero

items.explanation: Preserve the exact narrow evidence rather than upgrading it to a full protocol pass.
